review_notes: The file has only two theorems and no new definitions, structures or abbreviations, so it adds no competing concept. The primitivity hypothesis is spelled out as `Ideal.span (Set.range coeff) = ⊤`. I grepped the MvPowerSeries directory for `IsPrimitive` and for definitions whose name contains "primitive" and found none. Mathlib's `Polynomial.IsPrimitive` is for polynomials, not multivariate power series, so it is not the same concept. I did not search the other Formal Frontier libraries or Mathlib for an equivalent notion. The other types and operations used (`adicallyRestrictedSubring`, `polynomialRestrictedFinFirst`, `MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv`) are defined elsewhere. I did not check them for duplication, because they are outside this file.
